versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: From thence I went to another place to the west of the ends of the earth.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh na drugo mjesto, prema zapadu, na krajeve zemlje.

verses.text_en: And I saw a 〚burning〛 fire which ran without resting, and paused not from its course day or night but (ran) regularly.
verses.text_hr: Vidjeh 〚gorući〛 oganj koji je tekao bez odmora i nije zastajao na svojem putu ni danju ni noću, nego je tekao jednoliko.

verses.text_en: And I asked saying: ‘What is this which rests not?’
verses.text_hr: Upitah: ‘Što je ovo što ne miruje?’

verses.text_en: Then Raguel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me 〚and said unto me〛: ‘This course ⌜of fire⌝ 〚which thou hast seen〛 is the fire in the west which †persecutes† all the luminaries of heaven.’
verses.text_hr: Tada mi Raguel, jedan od svetih anđela koji bijaše sa mnom, odgovori 〚i reče〛: ‘Ovaj put ⌜ognja⌝ 〚koji si vidio〛 jest oganj na zapadu koji †progoni† sva nebeska svjetlila.’
